notes.title: NEW "BADDER" UPDATE !!
notes.content:
So, now no more weird and hard to handle targeting, our hero learned a lot in class so he is now able to target properly.
Also, mouse commands are now available !
There is also a tutorial to clarify there 2 buttons to shot, the usual shot, and the high aiming button, now it isn't no more a secret everybody will know it, but notice you must start a new game slot to see it !
And to finish, we added an indication for the cards, pretty sure many users didn't even know how to use them, it's actually simple, just hit the 3rd button to use them during the tests..

Hope you'll like it and thank you all !!!
